name: Fast Cut Talking Head
summary: Zero dead air. Jump cuts on every pause, framing that changes scale every 1-2 seconds, karaoke-glow captions, and clean glowing cards that slide in above the head to prove each point.
best_for: Creators, marketers, consultants and tech or business educators filming one talking-head setup. Tips, hot takes, frameworks and list videos from 20 to 60 seconds.
why_it_works: Removing every pause over 0.15s and alternating 100% and 115% framing creates a visual change every 1.2-2s, which resets attention before the viewer reaches for the swipe. The open loop in seconds 1-3 (the third one is the one nobody does) makes them stay for the payoff. Karaoke captions let the eye track the voice at 3-4 words per second. A takeover card every 6-8s is the pattern interrupt, and the payoff punch-in rewards the wait.

preview.motion_sample: A face placeholder jump-cuts between 100% and 115% scale every second while a glowing blue glass pill glides into the top band and a two-line caption lights word by word in yellow glow.
